Over 400 executives and leaders from more than 200 organizations gathered at the SNFCC Lighthouse for the third From AI to ROI conference, organized by Satori Analytics.

Key themes included AI-native organizations, children and AI, governance, and Sovereign AI.

The event featured live demos with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Claude, alongside presentations by young graduates from the AI Academy.
